summary: Confirmed electric-only sites (no water/sewer), reservable online, fees $35-45 (fee schedule unchanged: electric $45, non-electric $35, vehicle admission $5). Added 50-amp at some electric sites, 135 sites in all, showers, CampLife booking link, overflow sites first-come (fcfs some_sites).
